subject: Novamed: admin activity live-query handshake & sample policy
messages:
From: Irene Ellis <irene.ellis@novamed.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Novamed Security <security@novamed.com>
Date: Sun, 16 Aug 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: SOC 2 evidence: admin activity live-query and sample deliverable request

Hi Jonas,

Thanks for the intro call last week. Our SOC 2 vendor is asking for more concrete evidence around admin activity (who did what, when, from where) and we want to validate two things:

1) A one-off sample export that shows a 30-day slice of admin events for a single tenant (user + timestamp + action + target + IP).
2) Whether Redwood can provide a short-lived live-query endpoint or a runbook so our security team can run ad-hoc queries against admin activity during the assessment window.

Can you confirm:
- What exact event types you log for admin activity (privilege changes, role assignments, console logins, API keys, session terminations, etc.)
- Retention policy and redaction options for PII in the export
- Export formats and transport choices (S3 presigned, SFTP, Drive link, direct query)
- Any sampling policy or deterministic hashing you use when we request small slices

If possible we need a sample delivery by EOD Aug 18 so the assessor can proceed. I can share the exact time window once you confirm the format.

Appreciate the help — looping in Novamed security for visibility.

Best,
Irene Ellis
Security Operations Manager
Novamed

Attachment: request-template.xlsx (stated fields)
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Irene Ellis <irene.ellis@novamed.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 17 Aug 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC 2 evidence: admin activity live-query and sample deliverable request

Hi Irene — thanks for the clear list. We can support everything you mentioned. High level:

What we log (short):
- Administrative console actions: role updates, permission grants/revokes, user provisioning/deprovisioning
- Auth events: console login, MFA challenges, session start/end, API key usage (create/revoke)
- System-level operator actions: cluster deploys, config changes, restart actions
- Audit metadata: actor id, actor role, tenant id, target resource, operation verb, timestamp, source IP (V4/V6), request_id

Retention and redaction options:
- Default retention: 365 days for admin activity (configurable per-customer via Private/Dedicated agreements)
- PII redaction: we can redact email addresses or hash them deterministically (SHA256 with tenant salt) on export; we can also provide a raw PII bundle under an encrypted envelope for signed requests only

Export and live-query options:
- Static export: CSV / JSONL manifest, delivered via S3 presigned URL or secure Drive link (PGP-signed manifest available)
- Live query: short-lived query endpoint that returns JSONL slices; access scoped by an ephemeral token with 1-hour TTL and IP allowlist (recommended for assessor use)
- On-demand snapshot: incremental snapshots (daily deltas) with signed manifest and SHA256 checksums

Sampling policy we propose:
- Deterministic slice by timestamp + tenant_id with configurable size (e.g., 30k events)
- We can also apply field-level sampling (remove source IPs) if you need redaction for testers

Action items / timeline:
- Please confirm the tenant(s) + UTC window you want (Irene: send the exact 30-day window)
- We will prepare a redacted CSV sample and a short-lived live-query token by EOD Aug 18.

I've attached a short manifest and our internal playbook for running live queries. Looping Ben (security) and Kimberly (customer success) to coordinate packaging and any contractual checks.

Cheers,
Jonas Weber
Director, Customer Security (Redwood Inference)

Attachments: redwood_admin_manifest.csv (CSV, 9KB); redwood_live_query_playbook.pdf (PDF, 210KB)
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC 2 evidence: admin activity live-query and sample deliverable request

Jonas / Kim — quick internal plan before we ship:

Summary: Novamed wants a 30-day slice + a live-query capability for the assessor. We will provide a deterministic sample (tenant-scoped) and a 1-hour TTL live token with IP allowlist.

Notes / checklist:
- Confirmed event types (see Jonas summary).
- Redaction: default to deterministic SHA256(email+tenant_salt) for the sample CSV; keep a sealed PGP bundle for the raw export if Novamed signs the requester form.
- Packaging: CSV + JSONL manifest + checksum. For live queries, use ephemeral token + log-level read-only scope.
- Transport options: primary S3 presigned; fallback Drive link if customer prefers.

Question for Jonas: do we require an internal approval for releasing source IPs in the sample (Novamed asked for them)? If yes, we should route the sealed raw bundle to Legal & Security for signoff.

I added a small sample file (sample_admin_slice.jsonl) to validate schema.

-ben

Irene — thanks for the patience. We prepared the artifacts and the live-query option you requested. Summary of what's available now: 

What we delivered:
- redwood_admin_manifest.csv (attached): describes the schema for the admin events we exported (fields + types + hashing notes).
- sample_admin_slice.jsonl (attached): a 30-day tenant-scoped sample (email fields hashed; IPs redacted by default).
- Live-query: ephemeral token created for Novamed with 1-hour TTL. You can use the runbook (redwood_live_query_playbook.pdf) to run queries against the slice endpoint.

Transport + links:
- Primary: S3 presigned (valid 24 hours): https://redwood-s3-presigned.example/novamed/sample_admin_slice.jsonl (access guarded; please download and confirm receipt)
- Runbook & query console: https://app.redwood.ai/queries/handshake/novamed-2026-08

If you need source IPs included in the sample we will need signed approval (we can either provide hashed IPs or include raw IPs in the sealed PGP bundle). Let me know which you prefer and we will escalate for the sign-off.

Next steps for Novamed security:
- Confirm receipt and that the CSV/JSONL schema aligns with your assessor's requirements.
- If you need additional windowing or a larger slice, reply with the new UTC start/end.

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call if your assessor wants to walk through the fields.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Director, Customer Security
Redwood Inference
